panel_a_token_composition_of_selected_ev.denominator: sum of all selected evidence tokens across all 440 QA requests; repeated selections are counted repeatedly

panel_b_selection_rate_of_each_evidence_.denominator: available_count for the corresponding evidence type

measurement_notes.text_tokens: Evidence-only tokens measured with the common Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct tokenizer so evidence composition remains comparable across answer models.
measurement_notes.image_tokens: Evidence-only visual sequence tokens measured with the common Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct processor; GPT-5-mini API usage is reported separately in Panel C.
measurement_notes.vp_tokens: All VP crops actually expanded by selected VP actions, capped by max_vps_per_image from the run config.
measurement_notes.qa_usage_tokens: Direct GPT-5-mini API usage aggregated from answer call traces; includes complete prompts and is separate from evidence-only decomposition.
measurement_notes.selection_rate: selected_count divided by evidence availability count; unavailable evidence is excluded from the denominator.
